system.description: Beginning at 6th level, your technique with Anchors has taught you to be one for your team. Anchors you have placed while not in combat, last for 10 minutes and you can perceive both visually and auditorily through them. Activities within 30 feet of the Anchors can be perceived in this way by you as if you are there. Additionally, if a chakra or jutsu based effect is within 30 feet of an Anchor the Anchor radiates a small hum that only you can perceive, informing you where the effect originates from.
